findings.source_passage: "I will not go," said the stranger, "till you say aye to me. Do to me as you would have me do to you in the like case. For you too have a boy, Captain Ahab—though but a child, and nestling safely at home now—a child of your old age too—"
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'Meantime, now the stranger was still beseeching'
findings.why_it_matters: Gardiner's appeal to Ahab's own child is interpretively critical—it is the moral mirror that makes Ahab's refusal monstrous and thematically central to the chapter; without it, Ahab's 'may I forgive myself' loses its devastating irony and the chapter loses its ethical argument.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Gardiner's speech verbatim or nearly so: 'Do to me as you would have me do to you in the like case. For you too have a boy, Captain Ahab—though but a child, and nestling safely at home now—a child of your old age too.' This is the hinge on which the scene turns.

findings.source_passage: "Avast," cried Ahab—"touch not a rope-yarn"; then in a voice that prolongingly moulded every word—"Captain Gardiner, I will not do it."
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'in a voice that prolongingly moulded every word' is stylistically distinctive and signals the weight Melville places on Ahab's refusal; flattening it to plain dialogue erases the prose texture that makes the scene's gravity felt.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain the narrator's framing clause 'in a voice that prolongingly moulded every word' before the dialogue, and include 'touch not a rope-yarn' and the full exit order to Starbuck.

findings.source_passage: more fell than stepped into his boat, and returned to his ship
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'Hurriedly turning, with averted face, he descended into his cabin'
findings.why_it_matters: 'More fell than stepped' is a prosodically distinctive and critically noted phrase capturing Gardiner's devastation; the draft replaces it with the plain 'stepped into his boat,' erasing the emotive specificity.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace 'silently stepped into his boat' with 'more fell than stepped into his boat' to restore the source's signature phrasing.

findings.source_passage: Stubb to Flask, "that some one in that missing boat wore off that Captain's best coat; mayhap, his watch—he's so cursed anxious to get it back. Who ever heard of two pious whale-ships cruising after one missing whale-boat in the height of the whaling season?"
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'I will wager something now'
findings.why_it_matters: Stubb's comic cynicism—'his watch,' 'two pious whale-ships,' 'pale in the very buttons of his eyes'—is voice-establishing comic relief that makes the subsequent revelation of the son more devastating by contrast; the draft cuts it to a half-sentence, losing the rhetorical setup.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the full Stubb-to-Flask exchange including 'mayhap, his watch,' 'pale in the very buttons of his eyes,' and 'Who ever heard of two pious whale-ships' to preserve the tonal contrast the scene depends on.

findings.source_passage: leaving the strange captain transfixed at this unconditional and utter rejection of his so earnest suit
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'Hurriedly turning, with averted face, he descended into his cabin'
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'unconditional and utter rejection' and the image of Gardiner transfixed carry moral weight; their absence slightly flattens the pivot from Ahab's exit to Gardiner's departure.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a brief clause capturing Gardiner's stunned reaction before he moves to the side.

summary: The draft's most serious failure is the complete omission of Gardiner's appeal to Ahab's own child ('For you too have a boy, Captain Ahab'), which is the interpretive keystone of the chapter; combined with multiple instances of voice-flattening in Stubb's cynical aside, Ahab's exit framing, and the 'more fell than stepped' phrase, the draft requires regeneration.
